280028251.description:
Wyspell Natural Gemstone Kit
30 Polished Stone Varieties
Weight: 2.0 lbs
This comprehensive collection from Wyspell features 30 distinct varieties of natural gemstone chips, each housed in an individual glass bottle with a cork stopper and identifying label. Designed for metaphysical practices, mineral study, or decorative display, the set includes a "Flower of Life" crystal grid integrated into the box, a detailed Crystals Guide booklet, and a cleansing selenite stick. The stones represented include a diverse range of minerals including Ametrine, Blue Apatite, Labradorite, and Rutilated Quartz.
30 labeled glass jars containing various polished gemstone chips
Includes a selenite stick for crystal cleansing and energizing
Integrated "Flower of Life" crystal grid on the interior cover
Comprehensive crystals guide booklet with meanings and uses
Box dimensions approximately 11" L x 7.5" W x 2" H

The interior identification flap has become partially detached from the box binding, showing visible adhesive residue and clear tape repairs as seen in photos. The gemstones and glass bottles themselves are intact and in excellent condition. The exterior box shows minor shelf wear and some adhesive tape on the reverse side.

280393881.description:
Natural Quartz Crystal Slab
Polished Agate Geode Slice, White and Clear
Large Display Specimen, 19 x 12 Inches
This impressive natural quartz crystal slab features a highly polished face revealing a dense field of crystalline structures radiating toward a central geode cavity. The specimen displays clear and milky white quartz with subtle pale lavender transitions toward the interior, creating a sophisticated neutral palette for interior decor or mineral collections. Large-scale slabs like this are prized for their geological beauty and their ability to serve as striking centerpieces in modern or bohemian design.
Polished flat face showcasing natural crystal growth and termination patterns
Central druzy cavity with exposed crystalline points and natural facets
Natural rough exterior rind providing a rugged textural contrast to the polished surface
Significant display presence weighing 12 pounds and measuring 19 inches in length
Condition:
The polished face is smooth with high reflectivity and no significant scratches. The central crystal cavity is intact with natural terminations. As a natural geological specimen, the piece contains inherent internal fractures, inclusions, and varying crystal densities that are characteristic of the material. The outer edge retains its natural rough stone texture.

279367787.description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The specimens exhibit natural geological features, including internal fractures and surface textures inherent to natural minerals. The tumbled stones have a smooth, high-polish finish. The quartz cluster shows minor contact marks and natural inclusions typical of geological specimens.
